events.title: Iran Conflict Escalation
events.summary: The ongoing conflict between the US and Iran is escalating, with potential implications for global oil prices and geopolitical stability. The situation is being closely monitored by investors and policymakers. The US has imposed new sanctions on Iran, while Iran has threatened to retaliate.

actions.label: SHORT
actions.target: iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO)

events.reasoning: The escalating conflict between the US and Iran has the potential to disrupt global oil supplies, leading to higher prices and increased volatility in the energy sector. Investors may seek to buy safe-haven assets such as gold or the US dollar, while also considering short positions in oil-related stocks.

timeFrame.note: Monitor news and adjust positions accordingly

events.exitStrategy: Close positions if conflict de-escalates or oil prices stabilize
